---
title: "MLB Ballpark Leaderboard & Rankings"
subtitle: "Statcast 2026 Home Run Factor by Stadium"
format:
  html:
    page-layout: full
---

```{r}
#| label: setup-rankings
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| echo: false

library(tidyverse)
library(jsonlite)
library(plotly)

parks <- fromJSON("data/park_dimensions_factors.json") |>
  as_tibble()

parks_2026 <- parks |>
  filter(season == 2026, split == "All") |>
  arrange(desc(index_hr)) |>
  mutate(
    rank = row_number(),
    category = case_when(
      index_hr >= 105 ~ "HR Friendly (>105)",
      index_hr <= 95  ~ "Pitcher Friendly (<95)",
      TRUE            ~ "Neutral (95-105)"
    ),
    cat_color = case_when(
      index_hr >= 105 ~ "#ef4444",
      index_hr <= 95  ~ "#3b82f6",
      TRUE            ~ "#94a3b8"
    )
  )
```

## Stadium Home Run Factor Rankings (2026)

A score of **100** represents MLB average. Stadiums with an index above 100 boost home run production above league average, while stadiums below 100 suppress home runs.

::: {.glass-card}
```{r}
#| label: plot-rankings-bar
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| echo: false

p_rank <- plot_ly(
  data = parks_2026,
  y = ~reorder(venue_name, index_hr),
  x = ~index_hr,
  type = "bar",
  orientation = "h",
  color = ~category,
  colors = c("HR Friendly (>105)" = "#ef4444", "Neutral (95-105)" = "#64748b", "Pitcher Friendly (<95)" = "#3b82f6"),
  text = ~paste0(index_hr, " (", team, ")"),
  textposition = "outside",
  hoverinfo = "text",
  hovertext = ~paste0(
    "<b>#", rank, " ", venue_name, "</b><br>",
    "Team: ", team, " (", league, ")<br>",
    "HR Factor: ", index_hr, "<br>",
    "Avg Fence Dist: ", avg_fence_distance, " ft<br>",
    "Elevation: ", elevation, " ft<br>",
    "Roof: ", roof
  )
) |>
  layout(
    title = list(
      text = "<b>2026 MLB Ballparks Ranked by Statcast Home Run Factor</b>",
      font = list(color = "#ffffff", size = 16)
    ),
    height = 800,
    paper_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
    plot_bgcolor = "rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.6)",
    xaxis = list(
      title = "Home Run Factor (100 = MLB Average)",
      gridcolor = "rgba(51, 65, 85, 0.4)",
      color = "#94a3b8",
      range = c(60, 145)
    ),
    yaxis = list(
      title = "",
      gridcolor = "rgba(51, 65, 85, 0.2)",
      color = "#e2e8f0"
    ),
    legend = list(
      font = list(color = "#e2e8f0"),
      orientation = "h",
      y = 1.05
    )
  )

p_rank
```
:::

## Ballpark Profiles & Physical Specs

```{r}
#| label: rankings-cards
#| echo: false

cards <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(parks_2026)), \(i) {
  row <- parks_2026[i, ]
  badge_class <- if (row$index_hr >= 105) {
    "badge bg-danger"
  } else if (row$index_hr <= 95) {
    "badge bg-primary"
  } else {
    "badge bg-secondary"
  }
  
  htmltools::tags$div(
    class = "col",
    htmltools::tags$div(
      class = "glass-card h-100",
      style = paste0("border-top: 3px solid ", row$cat_color, ";"),
      htmltools::tags$div(
        class = "d-flex justify-content-between align-items-start mb-2",
        htmltools::tags$div(
          htmltools::tags$span(class = "text-secondary small", paste0("#", row$rank)),
          htmltools::tags$h5(class = "text-white mb-0 mt-1", row$venue_name),
          htmltools::tags$small(class = "text-muted", paste0(row$team, " • ", row$division, " (", row$city, ")"))
        ),
        htmltools::tags$span(class = paste0(badge_class, " fs-6"), paste0("HR ", row$index_hr))
      ),
      htmltools::tags$div(
        class = "small text-secondary mt-3 pt-2 border-top border-dark font-monospace",
        htmltools::tags$div(
          "LF Line: ", htmltools::tags$span(class = "text-light", paste0(row$distance_lf_line, " ft")),
          " | CF: ", htmltools::tags$span(class = "text-light", paste0(row$distance_cf, " ft")),
          " | RF Line: ", htmltools::tags$span(class = "text-light", paste0(row$distance_rf_line, " ft"))
        ),
        htmltools::tags$div(
          "Avg Fence: ", htmltools::tags$span(class = "text-light", paste0(row$avg_fence_distance, " ft")),
          " | Max Wall: ", htmltools::tags$span(class = "text-light", paste0(row$height_highest, " ft"))
        ),
        htmltools::tags$div(
          "Elevation: ", htmltools::tags$span(class = "text-light", paste0(row$elevation, " ft")),
          " | Roof: ", htmltools::tags$span(class = "text-light", row$roof)
        )
      )
    )
  )
})

htmltools::tags$div(
  class = "row row-cols-1 row-cols-md-2 row-cols-lg-3 g-3",
  cards
)
```
